content:
Is there code for nuclear spaces in mathlib4? I've seen in the slides of @Anatole Dedecker
in the "future work" part a goal to prove that

𝒟︀ and 𝒟︀′ are nuclear

I was curious if there is already a way to express this statement in Lean, or is the formalization of nuclearity also future work. If it's the latter, is it already in progress, or planned?
